  COUNT(*) AS numero_corse,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0), 2) AS percentuale_corse
FROM corsegs
GROUP BY fascia_oraria
ORDER BY
  MIN(
    CASE fascia_oraria
      WHEN 'Notte' THEN 0
      WHEN 'Mattina' THEN 1
      WHEN 'Pomeriggio' THEN 2
      WHEN 'Sera' THEN 3
    END
  );
